# Distinct match literal patterns within one evaluated match; signed zero aliases zero.
match 0 { 0 => 1, 0 => 2 } => error:duplicate match pattern
match 1 { 1 => 7, _ => 8, 1 => 9 } => error:duplicate match pattern
match 0 { 1 => 3, -0 => 4, 0 => 5 } => error:duplicate match pattern
match -2 { -2 => 7, -2 => 9 } => error:duplicate match pattern
match 1 { 0 => 3, 1 => 7 } => 7
match 0 { 0 => match 0 { 0 => 4 }, 1 => 9 } => 4
match 0 { 0 => 8, 1 => missing } => 8
1 || match 0 { 0 => 1, 0 => 2 } => 1
match 0 { 0 => 1, 0 => 1 + * } => error:duplicate match pattern
match 0 { 1 => 1, 2 => 2 } => error:no matching match arm
